summary.text: Clifford Hohman, also known as Cliff, is the Democratic candidate for Idaho House of Representatives District 13A in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces incumbent Republican Brent Crane.
Hohman works as an IT specialist and lives in Nampa.

paragraphs.text: Hohman was born in Indianapolis, Indiana, and earned a high school diploma from Decatur Central High School and a bachelor's degree from Northland College in 1999.
His career experience includes work as an IT specialist, fisheries research technician, public aquarist, warehouse picker and packer, forklift operator and motel maid.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he lives in a 100-year-old house in Nampa and works a day job.
Hohman advanced from the Democratic primary on May 19, 2026.
In the survey he said he does not accept corporate or super PAC donations and named affordable housing, healthcare access and public education as policy priorities.
